paragraphs: Shevna, a man of Jerusalem. Shabbat 12, beginning of b: Rashi explains he was an important man. Ri, in Tosafot, retains the spelling Shevna and distinguishes two biblical figures: Shevna who was over the household and Shevna the scribe. At the end of Ha-Memunnah they write that there was one. Rabbenu Tam’s reading, reported by Tosafot in Shabbat, is Shekhna, with kaf. See Maharit's responsum at the beginning of Shenei Dayyanei Gezerot, 104: there were two; see Tosafot there.
